guidelines.content:
Drugs currently recommended include:
1. Epinephrine (1:10,000)
2. Isotonic sodium chloride solution (0.9%) as an intravascular volume expansion agent
3. Data are insufficient to support recommending routine use of bicarbonate in neonatal
resuscitation; however, sodium bicarbonate (2 mEq/kg IV) may be useful in cases of
prolonged arrest after adequate ventilation is established.

Studies show that 0.9% saline provides better cardiac and blood pressure support to correct both
the metabolic acidosis itself and the underlying cause of the acidosis.
Use of sodium bicarbonate in the delivery room has been associated with an increased incidence
of intraventricular hemorrhage in VLBW infants.
Epinephrine should be considered only when the heart rate is below 60 beats/min and ventilation
has been established and provided for at least 30 seconds. The only exception to this rule may be
in infants born without a detectable pulse or heart rate.
The recommended dose is 0.01-0.03 mg/kg (0.1-0.3 mL of the 1:10,000 solution), preferably
administered intravenously (IV).
If vascular access cannot be established, epinephrine may be given via the ET tube, but in such
cases, the dose should be increased to 3 times the IV dose. Ensure that the small volume is not
deposited on the ET tube connector or in the lumen of the tube. Administration of epinephrine
may be followed with infusion of 0.5-1 mL of saline to ensure that the drug is delivered to the
lung, where it is absorbed and delivered to the heart.
Without sufficient ventilation, other therapies, including medications, will not be effective
in establishing adequate heart rate and perfusion

guidelines.title_en: Management of Hypotension in Preterm Infants
guidelines.content:
Hypotension occurs in up to 20% of very low birth weight infants, there are numerous
controversies surrounding the management of hypotension in the very low birth weight (VLBW)
infant. In extreme prematurity, the definition of hypotension varies, and the treatment remains
prone to personal preference. Fluctuation of blood pressure (BP) may be as important as its
absolute value and therefore should be minimized as much as possible in the first days of life.
Hypotension is associated with poor outcomes including an increased mortality and morbidities.
Invasive BP monitoring is the ideal, it is important to keep in consideration calibration and
accurate position of the transducer. Non-invasive methods of measuring BP tend to overestimate
readings in VLBW babies and therefore looking at trends is essential.

A rule of thumb is to take the gestational age or postmenstrual age to be the minimal of
mean blood pressure in premature infants.

Treatment of hypotension is indicated when infant shows clinical or lab evidence of poor
perfusion such as pallor, hypoxia, metabolic acidosis or poor urine output.

1-Volume expansion

- One bolus of normal saline of 10 mL/kg over 30-60 min can be used in the initial
management of hypotension.

- Repeat the same volume if there is hypovolemia or warm septic shock.

- In blood loss, PRBCs should be used.

- Albumin is not recommended.

2. Vasopressors
Dopamine:

- It acts on alpha, beta1, and dopaminergic adrenergic receptors.
- It should be considered as the first line inotropes for the treatment of hypotension in

VLBW infants.
- Start with 5 microgram/kg/min and increase by 5 mcg/kg/min if no response to a

maximum of 20 mcg/kg/min.
Dobutamine:

- It stimulates beta 1 adrenergic receptors with little effect on beta 2 or alpha receptors
- To be added if no response is achieved at 10 mcg/kg/min of dopamine.
- Start at 5 mcg/kg/min and can be increased gradually till 20 mcg/kg/min.

Epinephrine:
- It stimulates alpha and beta adrenergic receptors and causes vasodilatation at very
low doses.
- Several reports indicate that epinephrine can be safe and effective in neonatal shock.
- It should be used as 3rd line inotropes for the treatment of hypotension.
- Infusion should start at 0.1 mcg /kg/min and increased incrementally to a maximum
dose of 1 mcg/kg/min.

No evidence to support the use of Norepinephrine, Milrinone and Vasopressin in VLBW
infants with hypotension.

Hydrocortisone:
- It has been shown to increase blood pressure and reduce the duration of inotropic
support in this population.
- Prior to start of corticosteroid therapy a random serum cortisol is advisable to rule out
relative adrenal insufficiency.
- Start as 1 mg/kg /dose given q 8 hrs for 48-72 hrs.

Weaning of the Vasopressors:
- After 24 hrs, hydrocortisone dose should be assessed and weaned to 0.5 mg/kg q 8 hrs
if BP improves.
- Epinephrine should be weaned first by 0.05 mcg/kg/min every 1hr, faster weaning
may be required if MBP is too high.
- Dopamine /Dobutamine can be weaned by 2 mcg/kg/min every hour, faster weaning
(5 mcg/kg/min) may be required if MBP is too high.
references: 1. Saudi Neonatology Society Guidelines-2012.
2. Neofax 2011.
3. Paradisis M, Osborn D. Adrenaline for prevention of morbidity and mortality in preterm infants
with cardiovascular compromise. Cochrane Review, Neonatal, 2004:89:F168-F173.
4. Ng, P.C., et al., A Double-Blind, Randomized, Controlled Study of a "Stress Dose" of Hydrocortisone
for Rescue Treatment of Refractory Hypotension in Preterm Infants. Pediatrics, 2006; 117(2):367-375.

guidelines.content:
A consensus statement from the International Evidence-Based Group for Neonatal Pain
concluded that "tracheal intubation without the use of analgesia or sedation should be performed
only for resuscitation in the delivery room or for life-threatening situations associated with the
unavailability of intravenous access".

(1) Some of the reasons offered for not using premedications before intubation are
concern for adverse reactions and/or toxic effects of the medications, inadequate time
for administration of medications in emergency situations, and the perception that risk/
benefit ratios are worsened by using premedications.

(2) To avoid any of these adverse reactions, it is recommended to have the following:
1. Appropriate equipment such as an oxygen source, appropriately sized bags, face
masks, endotracheal tubes, stylet, laryngoscope, and suction.
2. Infants should have cardiorespiratory, oxygen saturation, and noninvasive blood
pressure monitoring during nonemergent intubation, and an end-tidal carbon
dioxide detector should be available. Intravenous access should preferably be
established, and the stomach should be decompressed.
3. Individuals who perform intubations should be experienced in the use of bag-mask
ventilation and be knowledgeable about the effects of the procedure of laryngoscopy
and intubation, as well as risks and benefits of premedication.
4. Individuals who are experts in using laryngeal mask airway (LMA) should be
around during intubation.
5. If intubation attempts are unsuccessful in these infants, then LMA should be used.

The medications used in intubation are different according to the corrected age and the clinical
condition of the infant such as presence high serum potassium.

A. Infants at < 34 wks corrected age:

1. Morphine 0.1 mg/kg IV.

2. Atropine 20 mcg/kg IV.
3. If still vigorous and difficult to intubate another dose of morphine 0.1 mg/kg IV or

Succinylcholine 1mg/kg IV should be used.
4. If after 2nd dose of morphine , the infant is still vigorous, then succinylcholine* 1mg/kg

IV should be given.

* Succinylcholine should be replaced with Rocuronium 1mg/kg IV if patient has acute
hyperkalemia > 6 mmol/dL.
B. Infants at  34 wks corrected age:

1. Midazolam 0.1 mg/kg IV.
2. Atropine 20 mcg/kg IV.
3. If still vigorous and difficult to intubate another dose of midazolam 0.1 mg/kg or

succinylcholine 1mg/kg IV should be used.
4. If after 2nd dose of midazolam the infant is still vigorous, succinylcholine* 1mg/kg

should be given.
* Succinylcholine should be replaced with Rocuronium 1mg/kg IV if patient has acute
hyperkalemia > 6 mmol/dL.
references: 1. Anand KJS, International Evidence-Based Group for Neonatal Pain. Consensus statement for the
prevention and management of pain in the newborn. Arch Pediatr Adolesc Med. 2001;155(2):173�180.
2. Kumar P, Denson SE, Mancuso TJ. Premedication for nonemergency endotracheal intubation in
the neonate. Pediatrics. 2010 Mar;125(3):608-15.

guidelines.title_en: Sucrose Analgesia for Simple Neonatal Procedures
guidelines.content:
Oral Sucrose has been shown to be an effective and safe treatment for reducing the pain response
of neonates. The aim is to reduce the discomfort caused by procedures performed in neonates.

Indications:

Painful procedures include but are not limited to venipuncture, peripheral venous line placement,
heel prick, arterial stab, and peripheral arterial line placement. Ways to reduce pain can be
through the use of pharmacological and non-pharmacological measures. Oral sucrose analgesia
may be used to eliminate crying, and significantly reduce the physiological stress of pain.

Exclusions:
1. Infants on continuous or scheduled pain medications (i.e., fentanyl, morphine, etc.).
2. Infants with preexisting hyperglycemia (accucheck > 8.5 mmol/L).
3. Major procedures (i.e., chest tube insertion, etc.).

Administration:

Dose: 0.2 mL of a 66.7% Sucrose Solution (Syrup BP, 0.67 g/ml).
No more than 4 oral sucrose doses are to be administered in any 24 hr period.
There is no minimum interval time between doses of oral sucrose.
Dosage Regimen:
When to administer:

1. Administer 24% Oral Sucrose 2-4 minutes prior to procedure.
2. If procedure > 15 minutes, may repeat in 2-5 min if pain score > 7, for a total of 3 doses

per procedure.
3. Maximum of 9 doses in a 24-hr period (i.e., 3 doses given for 3 procedures).

How to administer:
1.Term infants
a. Pacifier user: Dip the pacifier in 1-2 mL of 24% Oral Sucrose and allow the infant
to suck.
b. Nonpacifier user: place a few drops (2-8) of 24% Oral Sucrose (using a TB syringe)
to the anterior part (tip) of the tongue.

2. Preterm infants
a. Give 0.1-0.4 mL (using a TB syringe) and administer via nasogastric tube (NGT) or
to the anterior part of the tongue.

Contraindications:
1. Neonates with known fructose intolerance.
2. Neonates <1500 g and <31 weeks postconceptional age.
3. Neonates who are paralyzed.
4. Use with caution in infants who are intubated.

Storage:
Oral Sucrose Solution (Syrup BP) should be stored in the refrigerator and discarded one week
after the bottle has been opened.
References:

1. Stevens B, Yamada J, Ohlsson A. Sucrose analgesia in newborn infants undergoing painful
procedures. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, Issue 2, 2002.

2. Haouari N, Wood C, Griffiths G, Levene M.. The analgesic effect of sucrose in full term infants:
a randomized controlled trial. BMJ, 1995; 310: 1498-1500.

3. Johnston CC, Filion F, Snider L,et al. Routine sucrose analgesia during the first week of life in
neonates younger than 31 weeks' postconceptional age. Pediatrics, 2002;110:523-528.

4. Ietrak L, Burch K, Caravantes R, Knoerlein K, et al. Sucrose Analgesia: identifying potentially
better practices. Pediatrics, 2006;118:s197-s202.

guidelines.title_en: Non-Oliguric Hyperkalemia (NOHK) in Extremely Low Birth Weight Infants
guidelines.title_ru: Неолигурическая гиперкалиемия (NOHK) у детей с ЭНМТ
guidelines.content:
Hyperkalemia is often observed transiently in ELBW infants during the first days of life. The
reported incidence of NOHK varies widely but it can reach up to 60% of the ELBW infants.
It does not appear to be associated with renal failure, increased potassium intake, or excessive
bruising. Hyperkalemia may occur as a result of increased potassium intake, decreased
potassium excretion, or a shift of potassium from the intracellular to the extracellular space.
Hyperkalemia which develops in the absence of oliguria and potassium intake is known as
non-oliguric hyperkalemia. If untreated, it may cause fatal cardiac arrhythmia, periventricular
leukomalacia, brain hemorrhage, and even sudden death.

NOHK is defined as a plasma potassium level > 6.5 mmol/L in the absence of acute renal
failure during the first 72 hrs of age with urine output  1 mL/kg/hr.

Initial Work-Up:
� Examine the infant and check the rhythm strip on monitor.
� Check electrolytes, BUN/Creatinine, Calcium, Magnesium, Phosphorus, glucose and CBC.
� Repeat serum potassium for more confirmation.
� Check the urine output.
� Obtain EKG Lead II Strip; watch for changes associated with elevated potassium level.

If hyperkalemia is Confirmed do the Following:
1. Start Insulin and dextrose infusion as the first line of therapy (the ratio of infusion glucose to
regular insulin can be 10-15 g glucose to 0.5-1 Unit regular insulin, and the glucose infusion
rate can be maintained at least 6 mg/kg/min). A general dosing guide is: 0.05 Unit/kg regular
insulin + 0.5-1 g/kg using D10W (infuse dextrose over 15 min followed by insulin).
2. Intravenous salbutamol infusion as 4 mcg/kg every 4 hours can be used; however, no substantial
data show the superiority of salbutamol over insulin/dextrose for premature infants.
3. Exchange transfusion may be used as a last resort therapy.
4. Treatment can be discontinued when serum potassium is < 6 mmol/L.

Oral and rectal ion exchange resins should be avoided as they are ineffective and associated
with significant and potentially life threatening complications.
References:

1. Vemgal P, Ohlsson A. Interventions for non-oliguric hyperkalemia in preterm neonates. Cochrane
Database Syst Rev. 2012 May 16;5:CD005257. doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD005257.pub3.

Indications:
� Short-term treatment of apnea of prematurity in infants between 28-32 weeks GA.
� If patient is reintubated, caffeine citrate must be discontinued.

Established Benefits:
1. Facilitates extubation, with shorter duration of intubation and noninvasive respiratory support.
2. Reduces incidence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia/chronic lung disease.
3. Decreases need for treatment of patent ductus arteriosus.
4. Improves motor function and visual perception at 5-year follow-up.
5. Reduces severity of retinopathy of prematurity.

Pharmacokinetics:
� Therapeutic range: 7-20 mg/L.
� Vd: 0.8-0.9 L/kg.
� Half-life: 72-96 hours (range 40-230 hrs).
� Time to reach peak serum concentration: Within 30 minutes to 2 hrs (oral).

Dosing Regimen:

� Loading dose: 20 mg/kg/dose as caffeine citrate infuse over 30 minutes.
� Maintenance dose: 5-8 mg/kg/day as caffeine citrate once daily to start 24 hours after

the loading dose, given as IV over 10 minutes or as PO.
o If theophylline has been administered to the patient within the previous 3 days
(even if from another hospital), a full or modified loading dose (50-75% of a
loading dose) may be given

Discharge Criteria:
� Patient discharged home on caffeine citrate
o Patient must be apnea-free for at least 48 hrs.

� Discontinuation of caffeine citrate
o Once the patient is off caffeine citrate, he/she must be apnea-free for at least 7 days
as inpatient prior to hospital discharge.

guidelines.title_en: Maple Syrup Urine Disease (MSUD) Acute Decompensation Guideline
guidelines.content:
Treatment Includes:
1. Hydration:

� Start D101/2NS at 1.5-2 x maintenance; change to D10NS if Na level <140
� Add NaHCO3 if pH <7.2
� Add KCl if renal function not compromised
1. Correction of biochemical abnormalities:
� Hypoglycemia - administer 1-2 g/kg of glucose IV STAT; follow with hydration solution.
� Metabolic acidosis - administer NaHCO3 as a bolus (1 mEq/kg) if acutely acidotic with

pH <7.2 or bicarbonate level <14, followed by a continuous infusion. If hypernatremia
becomes a problem, reduce the rate of NaHCO3 drip; may replace with K acetate.
� Hyperammonemia - elevated ammonia reflects a secondary inhibition of the urea cycle.
As treatment for the organic acidemia proceeds, ammonia level should diminish.
2. Reversal of catabolism /promotion of anabolism:
� Glucose: Immediate hydration with fluid containing D10%; until PN can be initiated

��Patients with peripheral access: PN as follows:
D10%
AA (*Aminoplasmal) 0.5 g/kg (minimum of 0.5% in final solution)
IVFE 1-1.5 g/kg

��Patients with central access: PN as follows:
Dextrose @ GIR = 15 mg/kg/min up to 20 mg/kg/min
AA (*Aminoplasmal) 0.5 g/kg (minimum of 0.5% in final solution)
IV Fat Emulsion 1-1.5 g/kg

*Aminoplasmal AA will provide: 76 mg Leucine/g of AA, 39 mg Isoleucine/g AA, 48 mg
Valine/g AA.

� Insulin: Check glucose 1 hour after D10%/ PN initiation and follow the following insulin

sliding scale:

��If BG >16              contact MD to adjust sliding scale

��If BG 14.1-16 mmol/L   start insulin @ 0.05 Units/kg/hr

��If BG 12.1-14 mmol/L   start insulin @ 0.04 Units/kg/hr

��If BG 10-12 mmol/L     start insulin @ 0.03 Units/kg/hr

��If BG <10 mmol/L       hold insulin

��Check glucose q 1-2 hrs for the first 24 hours (to be left to the discretion of

the intensivist)

� Do not hold or reduce PN without adjusting insulin infusion to reduce risk of insulin

induced hypoglycemia.

4. Control of brain edema:
� Avoid infusion of hypotonic solutions
� Maintain Na level 140-145
� Furosemide 0.5-1 mg/kg prn to prevent water retention
� May consider mannitol 0.5 g/kg IV prn for life threatening increase in ICP

5. Elimination of toxic metabolites:
� Correction of acute metabolic abnormalities (acidosis, hypoglycemia) may help clear
factors contributing to encephalopathy associated with acute metabolic crises.
� Empiric co-factor administration:
��L-Carnitine (controversial): Free carnitine levels maybe low due to increased
esterification with organic acid metabolites.
Dose: 150 mg/kg/day IV/PO divided q 6-8 hrs.
� Dialysis (see #7 below)

6. Treatment of precipitating factors:
� Infection should be treated vigorously when possible. Note that neutropenia (and
thrombocytopenia) frequently accompany metabolic decompensation. Bone marrow
recovery is expected once the levels of toxic metabolites diminish significantly.
Empiric therapy: Ceftriaxone: 50-100 mg/kg/day IV once daily (higher end of dose in
suspected meningitis).

7. Cofactor supplementation:
� Thiamine 100 mg/day PO might be useful in cases of thiamine-responsive MSUD. Children
with established diagnoses will often be known whether or not they are responders.

8. Dialysis: Nephrology should be alerted early on in the hospital course
� Indicated in cases with:
��intractable metabolic acidosis
��unresponsive hyperammonemia (>600 �mol/L)
��coma
��severe electrolyte disturbances (usually iatrogenic)

� Clinical parameters
��Mental status
��Fluid balance
��Evidence of bleeding (if thrombocytopenic)
��Symptoms of infection (if neutropenic)
� Biochemical parameters
��Electrolytes, measured CO2, glucose, ammonia, blood gases, CBC with differential,
platelets

guidelines.title_en: TOF tet spell (cyanotic spell) — step-wise management
guidelines.content:
Hypoxic tet spell — emergency у Tetralogy of Fallot или other right-to-left shunt CHD.

Pathophysiology: stress ↑ catecholamines → ↑ infundibular obstruction + ↓ SVR → ↑ R→L shunt → severe hypoxemia.

Triggers: crying, feeding, defecation, bath, awakening, anesthesia induction, fever.

STEP-WISE LADDER:
1. Knee-to-chest position (↑ SVR mechanically → ↓ R→L shunt)
2. 100 % O₂ через face mask
3. Calm infant (decrease catecholamine surge)
4. Morphine 0.1-0.2 мг/кг IV/IM (sedation + ↓ infundibular spasm)
5. Volume bolus 10-20 мл/кг NS IV (↑ preload)
6. NaHCO₃ 1-2 мэкв/кг IV (correction acidosis при pH < 7.25)
7. Phenylephrine 5-20 мкг/кг IV bolus → infusion 0.1-0.5 мкг/кг/мин (pure α1 → ↑ SVR)
8. Esmolol 100-500 мкг/кг IV bolus → infusion 50-200 мкг/кг/мин (short β1-blocker → ↓ infundibular contractility)
9. ECMO + emergency surgery (Blalock-Taussig shunt или full repair)

AVOID: vasodilators (ACE-i, ARB), β2-agonists (albuterol — pulmonary vasodilation ↓ BF), inotropes alone, norepinephrine.

Prevention: avoid triggers, treat fever aggressively, iron supplementation (anemia exacerbates), β-blockers (propranolol) chronic prophylaxis, schedule full repair.
references: AHA / AAP — Pediatric Heart Disease guidelines
Park MK — Park's Pediatric Cardiology textbook
Allen HD et al. — Moss & Adams' Heart Disease
КР МЗ РФ "ВПС у детей" (2024)

guidelines.title_en: Thermal management — Golden Hour QI bundle
guidelines.title_ru: Thermal management — Golden Hour QI bundle
guidelines.content:
Golden hour thermal management critical для preterm и newborn outcomes. Hypothermia (< 36 °C) at admission ↑ mortality + IVH + RDS у preterm.

QI BUNDLE (gold standard):
1. Operating room temp ≥ 25 °C (≥ 26 °C для < 32 нед)
2. Servo-controlled radiant warmer + servo-controlled incubator
3. Polyethylene wrap (для < 32 нед — БЕЗ drying first; vernix + влага сохраняют warmth)
4. Chemical mattress (Transwarmer 40 °C)
5. Cap (woolen или quilted) — heat loss через scalp ≈ 25 % у newborn
6. Тёплые полотенца (для term)
7. Кенгуру (skin-to-skin) если стабилен

GOAL: Admission temp 36.5-37.5 °C

HEAT LOSS MECHANISMS:
- Evaporation 25-30 % (prevent: polyethylene wrap; dry term)
- Radiation 25-35 % (prevent: radiant warmer, warm OR, cap)
- Convection 15-20 % (prevent: warm OR, closed incubator)
- Conduction 5-10 % (prevent: pre-warmed surfaces, chemical mattress)

VLBW < 1500 г: inadvertent hypothermia 30-50 % при стандартной помощи; QI bundle снижает к < 5 %.

HYPOTHERMIA CONSEQUENCES:
- Mild (36.0-36.4 °C): cold stress, hypoglycemia, ↑ O₂ demand
- Moderate (32-35.9 °C): bradycardia, ↓ surfactant, RDS worsening, hypoglycemia
- Severe (< 32 °C): multi-organ dysfunction, DIC, ↑ mortality 50 % per °C drop
references: WHO Recommendations on Newborn Health (2017)
NRP 8 ed. 2021 — Chapter 7 Thermal Management
Helping Babies Survive (HBS) — Essential Care for Every Baby
Cochrane Plastic wrap для prevention hypothermia 2010

guidelines.title_ru: Управление гипотермией у новорождённого при транспорте
guidelines.content:
Классификация WHO (2017):
- Норма: 36.5-37.5 °C
- Холодовой стресс (mild): 36.0-36.4 °C
- Умеренная гипотермия: 32.0-35.9 °C
- Тяжёлая гипотермия: < 32.0 °C

Бортовая (rectal) температура. Аксиллярная — 0.3-0.5 °C ниже.

MANAGEMENT BY SEVERITY:

MILD (cold stress 36.0-36.4 °C):
- Сухие тёплые полотенца; cap для головы
- Кенгуру (кожа-к-коже) с матерью если стабилен
- Servo-controlled инкубатор
- Контроль температуры q15-30 мин
- Гликемия — гипогликемия часто сочетается
- Без активного rewarming если только mild

MODERATE (32-35.9 °C — активное согревание):
- Полиэтиленовая обёртка (wrap) + cap (для < 32 нед — без сушки сначала)
- Servo-controlled инкубатор max temp; air mode 38-39 °C
- Тёплый матрас (radiant warmer + chemical mattress 38-40 °C)
- Согревание скоростью 0.5 °C/ч (не быстрее — риск шока)
- Тёплые внутривенные жидкости; глюкоза при гипогликемии
- Мониторинг: ЧСС, RR, SpO₂, гликемия q30 мин

SEVERE (< 32 °C — экстренная интенсивная терапия):
- НЕМЕДЛЕННО: warm room, polyethylene wrap, cap, chemical mattress
- Servo-controlled инкубатор max + radiant warmer
- Тёплые IV жидкости (37 °C) — болюс 10-20 мл/кг при шоке
- Согревание 0.5 °C/ч (агрессивное rewarming → cold shock)
- Кардиомониторинг — высокий риск bradycardia, аритмий
- Газы крови, лактат, гликемия — метаболический ацидоз ожидаем
- Антибиотики (ампициллин + гентамицин) — sepsis в дифф. диагнозе
- Coag panel — DIC возможен
- Connect ECMO-центр / выезд бригады если ухудшается

TRANSPORT (WHO HBB protocol):
- Pre-transport температура: 36.5-37.5 °C
- Servo-controlled transport инкубатор
- Polyethylene wrap + chemical mattress + cap
- Документация temp каждые 15-30 мин

REWARMING SHOCK CAVEAT: rewarming быстрее 0.5 °C/ч может вызвать vasodilatation + гипотензию.
references: WHO Recommendations on Newborn Health (2017)
WHO Pocket Book of Hospital Care for Children (2013)
NRP 8 ed. 2021 — Chapter 7 Thermal Management
КР МЗ РФ "Гипотермия / Транспортировка н/р" (2024)
Helping Babies Survive — Essential Care for Every Baby

guidelines.content:
Multi-factorial assessment перед extubation от mechanical ventilation. Failure rate без protocol: 30-40 % preterm < 28 нед PMA. С proper assessment + caffeine: ↓ до 10-20 %.

6 CRITERIA:
1. Adequate spontaneous respiratory effort (regular pattern, не agonal; RR в pre-extubation range 40-60 у preterm)
2. Hemodynamic stability (no significant hypotension, off significant inotropes)
3. FiO₂ ≤ 30 % с adequate oxygenation (SpO₂ ≥ 90-95 %)
4. Minimal ventilator support (PEEP ≤ 5-7, PIP ≤ 16-18, rate ≤ 30)
5. Caffeine therapy started (если PMA < 32 нед) — therapeutic level (5-25 мкг/мл если monitored)
6. Spontaneous Breathing Trial (SBT) или CPAP trial successful (30-60 мин on minimum settings)

SBT METHOD:
- Wean ventilator к minimum (PEEP 5, PIP 14-16 или endotracheal CPAP, backup rate 5-10 или off)
- Monitor × 30-60 мин: SpO₂ ≥ 90-95 %, HR/BP stable, no significant retractions/grunting/nasal flaring, PaCO₂ acceptable (< 65, pH > 7.25)
- Если stable: proceed к extubation. Если deterioration: continue ventilator

PRE-EXTUBATION:
- Caffeine 20 мг/кг IV если не loading dose уже
- Pre-oxygenate FiO₂ + 10 % × 2 мин
- Suction airway
- Prepare CPAP / NIV at bedside

EXTUBATION:
- Brief positive pressure breath
- Remove ETT during expiration
- Immediate transition к CPAP 5-7 cmH₂O или NIV

POST-EXTUBATION:
- Continue caffeine
- Watch для apnea/brady/desat × 24 ч closely
- Reintubation criteria: respiratory failure, persistent severe apnea > 30 sec frequent, FiO₂ > 60 %, hemodynamic instability, severe acidosis (pH < 7.20)
- Successful extubation: ≥ 24 ч без reintubation
references: Sant'Anna GM et al. — neonatal extubation review
Manley BJ et al. — extubation predictors trial
Schmidt B et al. CAP trial NEJM 2007
Polin RA et al. — preterm respiratory management
КР МЗ РФ "ИВЛ у новорождённых" (2024)

guidelines.title_ru: Готовность к oral feeding у preterm
guidelines.content:
Assessment готовности preterm newborn к oral feeding (breast / bottle). Important transition step для discharge planning.

5-CRITERIA ASSESSMENT (PIOFRAS-style):

1. PHYSIOLOGIC STABILITY
   - HR stable (110-160 awake)
   - RR < 60
   - SpO₂ ≥ 92 % (или target range)
   - Temperature stable
   - ≥ 30 мин стабильности перед feeding

2. BEHAVIORAL STATE
   - Alert / quiet wakefulness
   - Не lethargic, не very fussy
   - Best state: quiet alert

3. ORAL MOTOR CUES
   - Rooting reflex (turn toward stimulus к щеке)
   - Tongue protrusion
   - Bringing hand к рту
   - Lip closure / sucking on pacifier

4. SUCKING PATTERN
   - Rhythmic (1 sec on / 1 sec off)
   - Sustained (≥ 30 sec without pause)
   - Coordinated (synchronized с swallow)

5. SAFE SWALLOW
   - No apnea during feeds
   - No bradycardia (HR drop > 20 % from baseline)
   - No desaturation (SpO₂ drop > 5 %)
   - Coordinated suck-swallow-breathe

PMA-BASED PROGRESSION:
- < 32 нед: minimal oral cues; gavage feeding
- 32-34 нед: developing cues; non-nutritive sucking
- 34-36 нед: increasing capacity; some oral feeds
- 36-38 нед: full oral feeds achievable
- ≥ 38 нед: coordinated breast/bottle feeds

TRANSITION STRATEGY:
Phase 1 (initial trials): 1-2 short oral attempts per day (5-10 мин) paired с gavage; pacing с pauses; head elevated position
Phase 2 (gradual): increase frequency; target full oral by Day 5-10
Phase 3 (full oral): > 80 % volumes oral consistently; weight gain ≥ 15-30 г/сут

ADJUNCTS: skin-to-skin (kangaroo), non-nutritive sucking (pacifier), specialized nipples (slow flow для preterm), speech/occupational therapy.
references: Lau C et al. — Oral feeding readiness in premature infants
Howe TH et al. — PIOFRAS scale
AAP COFN 2008 — Hospital Discharge High-Risk Neonate
Engle WA AAP COFN 2007 — Late preterm
КР МЗ РФ "Питание / Вскармливание н/р" (2024)

guidelines.content:
Heel-prick blood spot screening для metabolic disorders, congenital hypothyroidism, hemoglobinopathies, infections.

OPTIMAL TIMING:
- < 24 ч: rано — false negatives PKU/galactosemia
- 24-48 ч: acceptable
- 48-72 ч: OPTIMAL (после ≥ 24 ч feeds)
- > 72 ч: late — diagnosis delay
- > 7 дней: critical delay для catastrophic conditions

PRE-CONDITIONS:
- Adequate feeding ≥ 24 ч (для PKU, galactosemia)
- Преждевременно (< 32 нед): re-sample в 28 d жизни
- Blood transfusion / TPN: re-sample 60-120 d after

РФ РАСШИРЕННЫЙ SCREENING (с 2023, 36 заболеваний):
5 original (с 2007): PKU, congenital hypothyroidism, CAH, galactosemia, cystic fibrosis.
Extended (2023+): MSUD, MCAD, LCHAD/VLCAD, organic acidemias (PA, MMA, IVA), tyrosinemia I/II/III, citrullinemia, biotinidase deficiency, SCID, lysosomal disorders, и др.

CRITICAL CONDITIONS:
- PKU: severe CI без treatment; treatment by 3 нед — normal IQ
- Galactosemia: liver failure, sepsis, death; STOP lactose immediately если suspected
- CH: severe CI; start L-thyroxine by 2 нед
- CAH: salt-wasting crisis; cortisol + fludrocortisone immediate
- MCAD: sudden death; avoid fasting; emergency glucose
- Biotinidase: skin/neuro/deafness; biotin 5-20 мг/сут
- MSUD: toxic encephalopathy; BCAA-restricted diet, dialysis if acute

SAMPLE TECHNIQUE:
1. Pre-warm heel (warm towel × 3-5 мин или heel warmer)
2. Position: infant supine, heel down
3. Site: lateral or medial aspect of plantar heel (NOT center — bone)
4. Sterile lancet (depth 1-2 мм maximum)
5. First drop wiped, allow free flow
6. 5 separate spots on filter paper (Guthrie card)
7. Air dry 4 ч horizontal
8. Documentation: demographic info, time of birth, time of sample, feeding status

POSITIVE SCREEN: IMMEDIATE confirmatory testing + family contact + start treatment IF confirmed.
references: РФ Приказ МЗ РФ "Расширенный неонатальный скрининг" (2023, 2024)
US Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (RUSP)
UK NHS Newborn Blood Spot Screening
WHO 2007 Newborn Screening principles
AAP / ACMG Newborn Screening guidelines

guidelines.content:
Newborn pulse oximetry screening — standard of care для critical congenital heart disease (CCHD).

TIMING: 24-48 ч жизни (после first feed). Earlier = transition false positives.

SITES:
- Pre-ductal: right hand
- Post-ductal: foot

INTERPRETATION:
- PASS: SpO₂ ≥ 95 % AND difference < 3 %
- INDETERMINATE: SpO₂ 90-94 % both ИЛИ diff 3-5 % — repeat × 3 (15 мин interval)
- FAIL: SpO₂ < 90 % ANY extremity ИЛИ persistent abnormalities × 3 attempts → echocardiography обязательно

DETECTED CCHDs (most common):
- HLHS (1:5,000)
- TGA (1:5,000)
- TOF severe (1:3,500)
- TAPVR (1:15,000)
- Tricuspid atresia (1:10,000)
- Pulmonary atresia (1:10,000)
- Truncus arteriosus (1:10,000)
Total CCHD prevalence: 1.5-3 per 1,000 births.

DETECTION PERFORMANCE:
- Sensitivity: 75-90 % для CCHD
- Specificity: 99 %
- False positive rate: 0.5-1 %
- Combined с physical exam + family history → ~ 8-10 cases per 10,000

FAILED SCREEN → ACTIONS:
1. Echocardiography evaluation (anatomy, function, ductal status, coronary anatomy, branch PA, aortic arch)
2. If confirmed duct-dependent: start PGE1 0.05 мкг/кг/мин IV continuous
3. Pediatric cardiology consult
4. Transport к cardiac surgical center
5. NPO until decision о feeding strategy

PITFALLS:
- TGA: pre-ductal SpO₂ может быть higher than post-ductal (transposition physiology) — standard screen может miss
- Coarctation: pre-ductal adequate via L→R ductal shunt; symptoms develop после ductal closure (1-2 нед)
- Severe lung disease: false positive rate higher
references: AAP/AHA 2018 (Pediatrics 142:e20183064)
Mahle WT et al. 2011 endorsement
Wright J et al. — clinical implementation studies

guidelines.title_en: ROP screening — timing of first examination
guidelines.content:
Расчёт когда начинать ROP (retinopathy of prematurity) screening по AAP/AAO/AAPOS 2018 guidelines.

CRITERIA FOR SCREENING:
- GA ≤ 30+6 нед при рождении ИЛИ
- Birth weight ≤ 1500 г ИЛИ
- GA 31-32 нед или BW 1500-2000 г с unstable clinical course

TIMING OF FIRST EXAMINATION:
- GA ≤ 27 нед: 31 нед PMA
- GA 28-31 нед: 4 нед chronologic age
- GA 32 нед: 4 нед chronologic age
Whichever comes LATER (PMA-based or chronologic-based).

SUBSEQUENT EXAMINATIONS — frequency:
- Zone 1, stage 1-2: q1 нед
- Zone 1, stage 3 ± plus: TREATMENT в 72 ч
- Zone 2, stage 1-2: q2 нед
- Zone 2, stage 3 + plus: TREATMENT в 72 ч
- Zone 3: q2-3 нед
- Mature retina: discharge с eye exam follow-up
- AROP (aggressive posterior): TREATMENT в 72 ч

MYDRIATIC PROTOCOL (30 мин до exam):
- Cyclopentolate 0.2 % — 1 капля в каждый глаз
- Phenylephrine 1 % — 1 капля в каждый глаз
- Не tropicamide alone (insufficient mydriasis у dark iris)
- Caution: systemic effects (cyclopentolate apnea, phenylephrine HTN)

TREATMENT THRESHOLDS (Type 1 ROP — ETROP):
Treatment в 72 ч если:
- Zone 1, any stage с plus disease
- Zone 1 stage 3 без plus
- Zone 2 stage 2-3 с plus disease
- AROP

TREATMENT OPTIONS:
- Laser photocoagulation (gold standard)
- Anti-VEGF (bevacizumab, ranibizumab) — Zone 1, AROP
- Vitrectomy (Stage 4-5 retinal detachment)

LONG-TERM CONSEQUENCES:
- Myopia (most common)
- Strabismus
- Glaucoma (rare)
- Retinal detachment (severe ROP даже treated)
references: AAP/AAO/AAPOS 2018 (Pediatrics 142:e20183061)
Chiang MF et al. ICROP3 Ophthalmology 2021

BEAT-ROP trial (anti-VEGF)

guidelines.title_ru: Критерии выписки н/р из NICU (AAP COFN 2008)
guidelines.content:
AAP COFN 2008 5-criteria approach для готовности discharge. Все critirium met для safe discharge home.

5 КРИТЕРИЕВ (все обязательны):

1. PHYSIOLOGIC STABILITY
   - Apnea-free период ≥ 5-7 дней (без caffeine если applicable)
   - Normoxia в room air ИЛИ stable home O₂ requirement
   - Normothermia без external warming
   - Stable vital signs

2. ADEQUATE FEEDING
   - > 80 % volumes oral (breast, bottle, или combination)
   - Weight gain ≥ 15-30 г/сут sustained
   - Remaining volumes через NG OK для graduation

3. THERMOREGULATION
   - Stable в open crib (NICU minimum 24-72 ч)
   - Normothermia без incubator
   - Typically @ ~ 1700-1800 г и PMA 35-36 нед

4. ROUTINE CARE COMPLETE
   - Vaccines: HepB by birth + age-appropriate
   - Screenings: метаболика (TSH, PKU, MSUD и др.), hearing (ABR/OAE), critical CHD pulse oximetry
   - ROP (если preterm < 32 нед / < 1500 г)
   - Eye examination documented if BPD/preterm

5. PARENTAL READINESS
   - CPR training completed
   - Feeding skills demonstrated
   - Recognition of warning signs (sepsis, jaundice, poor feeding)
   - Medication administration training
   - Home equipment understanding

DISCHARGE PROTOCOL:
24-48 ч до discharge:
- Physical exam
- Weight check
- Education completed
- Screenings results reviewed
- Follow-up appointments arranged

DAY OF DISCHARGE:
- CAR SEAT CHALLENGE (90-120 мин для preterm < 37 нед или LBW < 2500 г)
- Final exam, weight, vital signs
- Removal IV / NG access
- Discharge medications dispensed
- Written/verbal instructions

AFTER DISCHARGE:
- Pediatrician follow-up 24-72 ч после
- Subspecialty: cardio, neuro, ophthal per condition
- Hearing screening repeat at 1-3 мес
- Developmental follow-up (high-risk)

LATE PRETERM CAVEATS (34-36 нед):
- Often "appears" mature
- Hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, feeding difficulties risks
- ↑ Readmission rate 1.5-2× term
- 48-72 ч hospital stay minimum recommended
references: AAP COFN 2008 Pediatrics 122:1119
Engle WA AAP COFN 2007 — Late preterm infants
Eichenwald EC AAP COFN 2018 — Apnea of prematurity
КР МЗ РФ "Выписка новорождённого" (2024)

guidelines.content:
Persistent Pulmonary Hypertension of Newborn (PPHN) — failure normal postnatal decline в pulmonary vascular resistance.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA:

CLINICAL:
1. Hypoxemia disproportionate к degree of lung disease
2. Differential cyanosis — pre-ductal SpO₂ > post-ductal by > 5-10 %
3. Hyperoxia test — PaO₂ < expected на 100 % O₂

ECHOCARDIOGRAPHY (gold standard):
- Tricuspid regurgitation jet velocity > 2.5 м/с (RV pressure ≥ 30 мм рт ст)
- RV pressure ≥ 2/3 systemic
- Septal flattening / paradoxical motion
- Right-to-left shunting через PDA / PFO
- PVR ↑ quantitatively

DIFFERENTIAL SpO₂ INTERPRETATION:
- < 3 %: Normal
- 3-5 %: Possible mild PPHN
- 5-10 %: PPHN likely
- > 10 %: PPHN definite
- Reverse differential (post > pre): TGA (transposition great arteries)

UNDERLYING CAUSES:
- MAS (meconium aspiration) — most common
- Idiopathic PPHN
- Sepsis-related
- CDH (congenital diaphragmatic hernia)
- RDS-associated
- Asphyxia-related
- Polycythemia
- Drug-induced (maternal SSRI / NSAID antenatal)

TREATMENT ALGORITHM:
1. Optimize ventilation (PEEP, MAP, oxygenation)
2. Correct underlying: acidosis, hypoCa, hypoglycemia
3. iNO 20 ppm trial × 30-60 мин (если OI ≥ 15-25)
4. Response: PaO₂ ↑ ≥ 20 ИЛИ OI ↓ ≥ 15 % за 30 мин
5. Continue iNO, taper к 5-10 ppm если response
6. If no response:
   - HFOV если на conventional
   - Sildenafil PO/IV (PDE5 inhibitor)
   - Milrinone 0.33-1 мкг/кг/мин (PDE3 inhibitor — RV support)
   - Vasopressors (dopamine ± epi) для perfusion
7. Failure → ECMO consult (OI ≥ 40 sustained × 4 ч)

SEVERITY (по OI):
- < 15: Mild
- 15-25: Moderate (iNO indication)
- 25-40: Severe (escalation)
- ≥ 40: Critical (ECMO criteria)

PROGNOSIS:
- Mortality severe PPHN: 10-30 %
- Survivors с BPD / CLD common
- Long-term pulmonary HTN rare если acute resolves
references: AHA 2019 PPHN Scientific Statement
AAP COFN — pediatric pulmonary hypertension
Konduri GG et al. — management guidelines
NINOS trial 1997
КР МЗ РФ "Персистирующая лёгочная гипертензия н/р" (2024)

guidelines.content:
AAP/ACOG 2014 Joint Statement — критерии диагноза "birth asphyxia" требуют наличия ВСЕХ 4 критериев.

4 КРИТЕРИЯ:
1. Метаболический ацидоз пуповинной артерии: pH < 7.0 ИЛИ BE ≥ -12 ммоль/л
2. Apgar 0-3 на 5-й или 10-й минуте
3. Клинические признаки neonatal encephalopathy (Sarnat I-III: tone abnormalities, judorги, lethargy)
4. Multi-organ dysfunction:
   - Renal: ОПН, ↑ Cr, oliguria
   - Кардио: ↑ troponin, hypotension, ↓ contractility
   - Liver: ↑ AST / ALT
   - Hematologic: thrombocytopenia, DIC
   - GI: NEC

МКБ-10 КОДЫ:
- P21.0 Severe birth asphyxia: pH < 7.0 + Apgar 0-3 + clinical encephalopathy (≥ 3 critirium)
- P21.1 Mild/moderate birth asphyxia (1-2 critirium)
- P21.9 Unspecified

P21.0 (severe) — критерий для therapeutic hypothermia (TH).

DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSIS encephalopathy:
- HIE: cord acidosis + Apgar low + multi-organ
- Stroke: focal seizures, MRI focal lesion
- Infection: fever, sepsis markers, CSF
- IEM: familial history, specific labs
- Congenital malformation: imaging, dysmorphic features
- Maternal drugs: history (anesthesia, opioids)

APGAR PITFALLS:
- Не для preterm (часто low independently of asphyxia)
- Maternal anesthesia / opioids → low Apgar без asphyxia
- Congenital malformations → low Apgar
- Используется как retrospective marker, не triage tool
references: AAP/ACOG 2014 Joint Statement: Neonatal Encephalopathy and Neurologic Outcome
ACOG Committee Opinion 348 (2006, reaff 2017): Definition of Term Asphyxia
WHO ICD-10 P21: Birth asphyxia
КР МЗ РФ "Гипоксически-ишемическая энцефалопатия" (2024)
NICHD / TOBY UK / SIBEN cooling criteria

guidelines.content:
Унифицированная классификация недоношенности по WHO + AAP + КР МЗ РФ, объединяющая GA и birth weight.

GA-BASED CLASSIFICATION:
- Extremely preterm: < 28+0 нед
- Very preterm: 28-31+6 нед
- Moderate preterm: 32-33+6 нед
- Late preterm: 34-36+6 нед
- Term: 37-41+6 нед
- Post-term: ≥ 42+0 нед

WEIGHT-BASED CLASSIFICATION:
- ELBW (extremely low): < 1000 г
- VLBW (very low): 1000-1499 г
- LBW (low): 1500-2499 г
- Normal: 2500-3999 г
- Macrosomia: ≥ 4000 г

MORTALITY / OUTCOMES BY GA:
- < 24 нед: Mortality 50-90 %, CP/cognitive 30-50 % survivors
- 24-25 нед: Mortality 30-50 %, CP 25-40 %
- 26-27 нед: Mortality 10-20 %, CP 15-25 %
- 28-32 нед: Mortality 5-10 %, CP 5-15 %
- 33-36 нед: Mortality 1-3 %, CP 1.5-2× term
- 37-41 нед: Mortality < 1 %, CP baseline

ANTICIPATORY CARE:

< 28 нед / ELBW: NICU level III, neonatologist immediate; surfactant + LISA early; UVC + UAC; thermal management; caffeine universal; TPN ASAP; imaging screening (head US, echo, ROP).

28-33 нед / VLBW: NICU; surfactant if RDS; caffeine if < 32 нед; vit K 0.5 мг IM; empiric abx if EOS suspected.

34-36 нед / LBW: палата интенсивной терапии or step-down; late preterm pitfalls (гипогликемия, гипотермия, hyperbili, RDS); 48-72 ч observation в роддоме.

Term + normal: routine ward, kangaroo, breastfeeding, vit K 1 мг IM.

ANTENATAL INTERVENTIONS:
- Betamethasone 12 мг × 2 IM: ↓ RDS, IVH, NEC, mortality 30-50 %
- Magnesium sulfate: neuroprotection (snijaeт CP riski)
- Tocolytics: buy 24-48 ч for steroids
- Antibiotics (PROM): ↓ neonatal sepsis
references: WHO ICD-11 P07 (preterm + LBW)
AAP / Engle WA 2009 — Late preterm definition
КР МЗ РФ "Преждевременные роды" / "Недоношенность" (2024)
Cochrane antenatal corticosteroids
NICE NG201 — Preterm labour and birth

guidelines.content:
Классификация intrauterine growth restriction (ЗВУР, IUGR) и перцентилей массы для GA по Fenton 2025 (preterm) или Olsen 2010 / Intergrowth-21st (term).

КАТЕГОРИИ:
- LGA (large for GA): > 90-й перцентиль — гипогликемия, birth trauma, IDM cardiomyopathy
- AGA (appropriate for GA): 10-90-й перцентиль — норма
- SGA mild (small for GA): 3-9-й перцентиль — placental insuff, asymmetric IUGR
- SGA severe: < 3-й перцентиль — chromosomal/infect, symmetric IUGR

SYMMETRIC vs ASYMMETRIC IUGR:

SYMMETRIC (early onset, 1-2 trimester):
- ↓ Height + weight + head circumference (proportional)
- Causes: chromosomal (trisomy 13, 18, 21, Turner), TORCH (CMV, toxoplasma, rubella, syphilis), maternal severe malnutrition, alcohol/smoking/drugs, genetic syndromes
- Prognosis: worse

ASYMMETRIC (late onset, 3 trimester):
- Head sparing; ↓ weight + abdominal circumference
- Causes: placental insufficiency (preeclampsia, hypertension), maternal vascular disease, multifetal pregnancy, late maternal nutrition issues
- Prognosis: better, often catches up

DIAGNOSTIC WORKUP (SGA severe < 3-й перцентиль):
- Chromosomal: microarray (replaces karyotype если negative U/S)
- TORCH: CMV PCR (urine), syphilis serology, toxoplasma IgM, HIV, hepatitis
- Imaging: head U/S (CMV calcifications), echo (CHD)
- Metabolic: thyroid, IGF-1 levels
- Family: parental measurements (constitutional vs IUGR)

CLINICAL MANAGEMENT:

LGA: glucose monitoring (q30-60 мин × 4-12 ч), birth trauma assessment (ключица, brachial plexus, hum head), maternal diabetes evaluation, echo если IDM или sympotomatic.

SGA mild (asymmetric): glucose monitoring q30 мин × 4 ч then q4h × 24-48 ч; polyethylene wrap, cap (thermal); polycythemia screen (Hct ≥ 65 % → partial exchange); adequate feeding for catch-up.

SGA severe: all above PLUS workup chromosomal + infection, brain imaging, cardio assessment, TPN if energy intake inadequate, multidisciplinary team, family counselling.

LONG-TERM OUTCOMES:
- LGA: ↑ risk type 2 DM
- SGA mild: + 2-3 % neurodev impairment, mostly catches up
- SGA severe: + 10-25 % NDI, incomplete catch-up, ↑ adult metabolic risk (DM, HTN)
references: ACOG Committee Opinion 800 (2020) — Fetal Growth Restriction
WHO ICD-11 P05 (Slow fetal growth)
Fenton 2025 (Pediatrics 155:e2024069896)
Olsen 2010
Intergrowth-21st (intergrowth21.com)
КР МЗ РФ "Задержка роста плода / новорождённого" (2024)

guidelines.content:
Радиологическая + клиническая классификация respiratory distress syndrome в 4 степени тяжести (КР МЗ РФ + Avery + European Consensus 2022).

РАДИОЛОГИЧЕСКИЕ СТЕПЕНИ:

I (mild):
- X-ray: слабый ретикулогранулярный pattern, slight ↓ aeration
- Клиника: FiO₂ 22-30 %
- Тактика: spontaneous breathing + ↑ FiO₂; CPAP if needed

II (moderate):
- X-ray: diffuse reticulogranular + air bronchograms
- Клиника: FiO₂ 31-50 %, CPAP
- Тактика: CPAP/pNCPAP (PEEP 5-7); surfactant если FiO₂ ≥ 30 % persistent (LISA/INSURE preferred)

III (severe):
- X-ray: confluent opacification + prominent air bronchograms
- Клиника: FiO₂ 51-80 %, MV/surfactant
- Тактика: MV + surfactant 100-200 мг/кг ASAP; repeat if FiO₂ ≥ 30 % через 6-12 ч; antibiotics empiric до исключения sepsis

IV (very severe):
- X-ray: "white lung" — total opacification, heart silhouette не видна
- Клиника: FiO₂ > 80 %
- Тактика: MV + multiple surfactant doses + advanced vent; HFOV если refractory; iNO если PPHN; hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8h рассмотреть; inotropes; ECMO consult (OI ≥ 40)

EUROPEAN CONSENSUS 2022 (Sweet et al.):
1. Antenatal corticosteroids — betamethasone × 2 за 24-48 ч до родов
2. Magnesium sulfate antepartum < 32 нед — neuroprotection
3. Delayed cord clamping ≥ 60 sec
4. CPAP first при стабильности (≥ 26 нед)
5. LISA preferred для GA ≥ 26 нед on CPAP
6. Surfactant timing: ASAP после diagnosis (early > late)
7. Permissive hypercapnia — PaCO₂ 45-55, pH ≥ 7.25

DIFFERENTIAL ДИАГНОЗ "white lung":
- RDS: onset 1-4 ч, preterm, surfactant deficiency
- TTN: term/late preterm, resolves 24-72 ч
- Congenital pneumonia: early onset, sepsis markers
- MAS: term, meconium-stained, post-term
- CDH: polyhydramnios, scaphoid abdomen
- PDA flooding: late presentation, murmur
- Air leak (PIE): cystic appearance, MV history

RISK FACTORS for severe RDS (OR):
- GA < 28 нед: 5-10×
- C-section без labor: 1.5-2×
- Maternal diabetes (GDM): 1.5-2×
- Family history: 1.3-1.5×
- Male sex: 1.3-1.5×
references: КР МЗ РФ "Респираторный дистресс синдром у новорождённого" (2024)
Sweet DG et al. European Consensus 2022 (Neonatology 2023;120:3)
Avery's Diseases of the Newborn 11th ed.
Polin RA, AAP COFN 2014 — Surfactant administration
Cochrane Surfactant Reviews 2018-2020

guidelines.title_en: Neonatal cholestasis — diagnostic criteria and workup
guidelines.title_ru: Холестаз у новорождённого — критерии и workup
guidelines.content:
Cholestasis (conjugated hyperbilirubinemia) у н/р — pathologic, требует workup. Biliary atresia — most urgent diagnosis (Kasai surgery в 30-60 d критично).

DEFINITION:
- Total bilirubin ≤ 5 мг/дл: conjugated > 1.0 мг/дл (17 мкмоль/л)
- Total bilirubin > 5 мг/дл: conjugated > 20 % total

SEVERITY BANDS (мг/дл conjugated):
- < 1.0: No cholestasis
- 1.0-2.0: Mild
- 2.0-5.0: Moderate
- > 5.0: Severe

CAUSES (по frequency):
1. Biliary Atresia (most urgent — Kasai в 30-60 d)
2. Idiopathic neonatal hepatitis
3. TPN-associated cholestasis
4. Cytomegalovirus (CMV) — most common congenital infection
5. α-1 antitrypsin deficiency
6. Galactosemia (NEONATAL EMERGENCY — STOP lactose immediately)
7. Hypothyroidism / hypopituitarism
8. Bile acid synthesis defects (PFIC)
9. Cystic fibrosis
10. Sepsis (endotoxin-mediated)

WORKUP при cholestasis:

INITIAL LABS:
- LFTs: AST, ALT, GGT, alkaline phosphatase, total + conjugated bilirubin
- INR/PT (vit K-dependent factors)
- Albumin, total protein
- Glucose, ammonia
- TSH, free T4
- α-1 antitrypsin level + phenotype
- Galactose-1-phosphate (urine reducing substances)
- Bile acids (urine + serum)
- CMV PCR (urine + blood)
- Newborn screening review

IMAGING:
- Abdominal U/S (liver, gallbladder, biliary tree)
- HIDA scan (cholescintigraphy — hepatic excretion assessment)
- MR cholangiography (если equivocal)
- Liver biopsy (если diagnosis unclear)

BILIARY ATRESIA — special considerations:
- Kasai portoenterostomy в 30-60 d жизни
- 10-yr native liver survival:
  - Kasai 30-60 d: 30-50 %
  - Kasai > 90 d: 5-10 %
- Eventually liver transplant у many

Clinical features BA:
- Jaundice persistent > 2 нед
- Acholic / pale stools (VERY suspicious)
- Dark urine (bilirubinuria)
- Hepatomegaly
- Failure to thrive

TPN-ASSOCIATED CHOLESTASIS:
Risk factors: long-term TPN (> 14-30 d), preterm < 32 нед, sepsis, lack enteral feeding.
Management:
- Cycle PN if possible (12-16 ч infusion)
- Lipid reduction to 1-2 г/кг/сут
- Fish oil emulsion (Omegaven, SMOFlipid)
- Trophic feeding ASAP
- Ursodeoxycholic acid 10-15 мг/кг q12h PO

GALACTOSEMIA — emergency:
- Urinary reducing substances positive
- ↑ Direct bilirubin
- Hypoglycemia
- Vomiting / failure to thrive
- Treatment: STOP lactose / breast milk immediately; galactose-free formula (soy or hydrolyzed); lifelong dietary restriction

VIT K administration в cholestasis:
- Fat-soluble vitamin malabsorption ↑
- Vit K 1 мг IM/IV q24h × 3 days (correction coagulopathy)
- Vit ADE supplementation chronic
references: Fawaz R et al. NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 Guideline (JPGN 64:154)
AAP CFN — Cholestasis in newborns
КР МЗ РФ "Холестаз новорождённого / Билиарная атрезия" (2024)

guidelines.title_ru: Therapeutic hypothermia (TH) — критерии охлаждения при HIE
guidelines.content:
NICHD/TOBY/SIBEN criteria для therapeutic hypothermia (TH) у term/late preterm с HIE. Окно ≤ 6 ч от рождения.

ELIGIBILITY — все 3 критерия должны быть met:

CRITERION A (Physiologic):
Любое из:
- Cord pH ≤ 7.00 (артериальная или венозная)
- Cord BE ≥ -12 ммоль/л
- Apgar ≤ 5 на 10-й минуте
- Continued resuscitation > 10 мин (PPV/intubation)

CRITERION B (Perinatal event):
Acute perinatal event консistent с asphyxia:
- Sentinel event (ruptura uteri, abruption, cord prolapse, fetal exsanguination)
- Severe heart rate abnormality during labor
- Severe maternal/fetal compromise

CRITERION C (Clinical):
Moderate-severe encephalopathy (Sarnat II-III):
- Altered consciousness (lethargy, stupor, coma)
- Abnormal tone (hypotonia, hypertonia)
- Abnormal reflexes (Moro, sucking, grasp diminished/absent)
- Autonomic dysfunction (pupils, HR variability)
- Seizures (если present)
ИЛИ aEEG / EEG abnormalities (moderate-severe encephalopathy pattern)

TIMING:
- ≤ 6 ч от рождения — start cooling
- Beyond 6 ч — efficacy questionable; consider если still mild encephalopathy

CONTRAINDICATIONS (absolute):
- GA < 36 нед (TOBY) или < 35 нед (NICHD)
- Birth weight < 1800 г
- Major chromosomal anomaly или genetic syndrome
- Major congenital anomaly incompatible с life
- Active major bleeding
- Severe head trauma (intra-cranial hemorrhage)

PROTOCOL:
- Target: rectal/esophageal temperature 33.0-34.0 °C
- Duration: 72 ч cooling
- Rewarming: gradual 0.5 °C/ч до 36.5-37.5 °C
- Continuous monitoring: HR, BP, SpO₂, temperature, EEG
- Sedation: morphine 10-30 мкг/кг/ч (anti-shivering)
- Anti-seizure: phenobarbital prn

OUTCOMES (NICHD trial Shankaran 2005):
- ↓ Death + disability composite outcome
- NNT ~ 8 для prevention major adverse outcome
- Best outcomes у moderate HIE (Sarnat II)
- Severe HIE (Sarnat III): mortality 30-50 % даже с TH; major neurodev disability в survivors

ADJUNCTS (under investigation):
- Erythropoietin (NEAT trial pending)
- Magnesium sulfate (limited evidence postnatal)
- Allopurinol (xanthine oxidase inhibitor)
- Melatonin (anti-oxidant)
references: Shankaran S et al. NICHD trial NEJM 2005;353:1574
Azzopardi DV et al. TOBY trial NEJM 2009;361:1349
ILCOR / SIBEN consensus on neonatal HIE
AAP COFN 2014 — Hypothermia and neonatal encephalopathy
КР МЗ РФ "Гипоксически-ишемическая энцефалопатия" (2024)

guidelines.content:
Календарь вакцинации новорождённого с разбивкой по регионам.

ПЕРВЫЕ 24 ЧАСА ЖИЗНИ:
- РФ (Приказ № 1122н): HepB-1 (рекомбинантная)
- UZ (нацкалендарь): HepB-1
- WHO: HepB birth dose всем newborns
- US/CDC: HepB при рождении

БЦЖ (3-7 ДНЕЙ ЖИЗНИ):
- РФ: БЦЖ-М (или БЦЖ для контактов)
- UZ: БЦЖ в роддоме перед выпиской
- WHO: BCG единичная dose в endemic regions
Противопоказания: ELBW < 2000 г, активные ID, мать с TB

СХЕМА РФ (Приказ МЗ РФ № 1122н от 06.12.2021):
- 24 ч: HepB-1
- 3-7 d: БЦЖ-М
- 1 мес: HepB-2
- 2 мес: HepB-3 (риск-группа); ПКВ-1
- 3 мес: DTP-1, IPV-1, ХИБ-1 (риск), ПКВ-1
- 4.5 мес: DTP-2, IPV-2, ХИБ-2, ПКВ-2
- 6 мес: DTP-3, IPV-3, HepB-4, OPV-1
- 12 мес: MMR (КПК)
- 15 мес: ПКВ revaccination
- 18 мес: DTP-4, OPV-2, ХИБ revaccination
- 20 мес: OPV-3

СХЕМА UZ (нацкалендарь):
- 24 ч: HepB-1
- роддом: БЦЖ
- 2 мес: Pentavalent (DTP-HepB-Hib) -1, OPV-1, PCV-1
- 4 мес: Pentavalent-2, OPV-2, PCV-2
- 6 мес: Pentavalent-3, OPV-3, PCV-3
- 9-12 мес: MMR-1
- 15 мес: MMR-2
- 18 мес: DTP-4, OPV-4

СХЕМА WHO/CDC:
- Birth: HepB-1, BCG (endemic)
- 2 мес: DTaP-1, IPV-1, HepB-2, Hib-1, PCV-1, Rotavirus-1
- 4 мес: DTaP-2, IPV-2, Hib-2, PCV-2, Rotavirus-2
- 6 мес: DTaP-3, HepB-3, Hib-3 (some), PCV-3, Rotavirus-3, Influenza (annual)
- 12-15 мес: MMR-1, Varicella-1, Hib booster, PCV-4
- 12-23 мес: HepA-1
- 15-18 мес: DTaP-4

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS:
- Preterm: vaccinate по chronologic age (НЕ corrected)
- ELBW < 2000 г: HepB 4-dose schedule (0, 1, 2, 6 мес) для better seroconversion
- Immunocompromised: live vaccines contraindicated (MMR, varicella, BCG, oral polio)
- IPV preferred over OPV first 3 doses
- DTP: pertussis component — DTaP preferred современно
- Influenza: annual ≥ 6 мес
- RSV palivizumab (passive): preterm < 32 нед, BPD, CHD

PERTUSSIS у newborn:
- Severe disease (apnea, brady, mortality 1-3 % у < 3 мес)
- Maternal Tdap pregnancy (27-36 нед) — passive protection × 2-3 мес

guidelines.content:
EARLY-ONSET SEPSIS (EOS, < 72 ч):

RISK STRATIFICATION:
- Term/late preterm (≥ 34 нед): Kaiser EOS calculator (Bayesian probability) — см. калькулятор
- Preterm (≤ 34 нед): Puopolo EOS tiered (AAP COFN 2018) — см. калькулятор

EMPIRIC ANTIBIOTICS:
- First-line: Ампициллин 50 мг/кг q12h-q8h + Гентамицин 4-5 мг/кг q24-48h
- Meningitis suspected: Ампициллин 100 мг/кг + Цефотаксим (НЕ ceftriaxone у н/р) 50 мг/кг q12h-q6h
- HAP / multi-drug resistant suspect: Меропенем 20-40 мг/кг q8-12h

WORKUP:
- Blood culture (1 мл minimum), CBC + diff, CRP + procalcitonin
- LP если meningitis suspected (signs: lethargy, seizure, bulging fontanelle)
- Urine culture (LOS только > 7 d age)
- Skin / surface cultures если vesicles или maternal HSV
- Maternal cultures + risk factors (GBS status, PROM, хориоамнионит)

DURATION:
- Sepsis (positive culture): 7-10 дней
- Sepsis (negative + clinical improvement): 36-48 ч → discontinue
- Meningitis: 14-21 день (Listeria 21+)
- LP repeat 24-48 ч после initiation если CSF positive

LATE-ONSET SEPSIS (LOS, > 72 ч):
- Pathogens: CONS (~ 40 % preterm), MRSA, gram-negative
- Empiric: Ванкомицин + Гентамицин (или меропенем если MDR risk)
- Severity: nSOFA score (см. калькулятор)

ADJUNCTS (controversial):
- IVIG: NOT routine (INIS 2011 NEJM — no benefit)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8h: refractory hypotension (relative adrenal insuff)
- Vasopressors: dopamine → epi (cold shock); norepi (warm shock)

MORTALITY:
- EOS: 5-15 % term, 30-50 % VLBW
- LOS: 10-30 % VLBW, lower у term
- nSOFA ≥ 4: чувствительность 67 % для смерти от LOS
references: Kaiser EOS update Pediatrics 2024;154(4):e2023065267
Puopolo KM et al. Pediatrics 2017;139:e20162426
AAP COFN 2018 — Management of Infants ≤ 34 weeks
Wynn JL et al. JAMA Pediatr 2020;174:e202531 (nSOFA)
Brocklehurst P et al. INIS trial NEJM 2011;365:1201
AAP Red Book 2021-2024

guidelines.content:
STAGING (Bell modified Walsh-Kliegman 1986) — см. калькулятор:
- IA/IB Suspected NEC, mild systemic
- IIA Definite NEC mild (X-ray pneumatosis или dilatation)
- IIB Definite moderate (+ acidosis, ↓Plt, RLQ mass)
- IIIA Advanced без perforation (peritonitis, DIC)
- IIIB Advanced с perforation (pneumoperitoneum)

ALL STAGES — IMMEDIATE STEPS:
1. NPO (no oral / enteral feeds)
2. NG tube — gravity drainage (decompression)
3. IV access — central preferred (UVC если ≤ 7 d жизни)
4. CBC + diff, CRP, electrolytes, blood gas, lactate, INR/PT, fibrinogen, type+crossmatch
5. Blood cultures × 1-2 sites
6. Stool cultures + occult blood
7. Abdominal X-ray supine + lateral decubitus (free air)
8. Pain management (morphine 0.05 мг/кг q4h prn)

ANTIBIOTICS:
- Stage I-IIA: Ампициллин 50 мг/кг q8-12h + Гентамицин 4-5 мг/кг (48-72 ч если cultures negative)
- Stage IIB+ (definite NEC): TRIPLE therapy:
  · Ампициллин 50-100 мг/кг q8-12h
  · Гентамицин 4-5 мг/кг q24-48h
  · Метронидазол 7.5 мг/кг q8-24h (anaerobic coverage)
- Stage IIIB (perforation) или MDR: Меропенем 30 мг/кг q8h ± Ванкомицин

DURATION:
- Stage IA/IB: 48-72 ч (если cultures negative + improvement)
- Stage IIA: 7-10 дней
- Stage IIB: 14 дней
- Stage IIIA-IIIB: 14-21 день

SURGICAL CONSULT:
- Stage IIB: surgical eval (RLQ mass, ascites)
- Stage IIIA: aggressive medical, surgery if progressive
- Stage IIIB (perforation): EMERGENCY laparotomy + bowel resection ± ostomy (ileostomy + mucous fistula most common)
- Penrose drain — temporizing для unstable preterm < 1000 г

SUPPORTIVE CARE:
- TPN — start ASAP (см. neo-tpn calc)
- Ventilator support if respiratory distress
- Hemodynamic support: NS bolus 10-20 мл/кг, dopamine if hypotensive
- DIC management: FFP, platelets, cryoprecipitate as needed
- Pain control: morphine 0.05-0.1 мг/кг q4h prn

ENTERAL RE-FEEDING:
- Stage I: 48-72 ч после стабилизации
- Stage II: 7-14 дней NPO
- Stage III: 21+ дней
- Restart slowly: 10-20 мл/кг/сут trophic, increase gradually (ESPGHAN 2022)

LONG-TERM:
- Short bowel syndrome у ~ 10 % survivors (особенно после resection > 50 % bowel)
- Cholestasis ассоциирован с длительным TPN
- Strictures в 10-25 %
- Neurodevelopmental delay ↑ при NEC III + sepsis

PREVENTION:
- Breast milk preferred (vs formula)
- Slow feeds advancement у VLBW (ESPGHAN 2022)
- Probiotics — recommended при IIB+ для prevention recurrence (NICE 2024); снижают NEC incidence на ~ 40 % (Cochrane 2017)
references: Bell MJ et al. Ann Surg 1978;187:1
Walsh MC, Kliegman RM. Pediatr Clin North Am 1986;33:179
AAP / ACS 2020 surgical guidelines
Cochrane Antibiotics for NEC 2017
ESPGHAN 2022 EN Position Paper
КР МЗ РФ "НЭК" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DIAGNOSIS:

ECHO (gold standard):
- PDA size > 1.5 мм (значимый)
- LA/Ao ratio > 1.4
- Descending aorta — diastolic flow reverse
- Continuous murmur (machinery murmur left infra-clavicular)
- Hemodynamic significance: respiratory deterioration, pulmonary edema, BP wide pulse pressure, bounding pulses

CLASSIFICATION:
- Asymptomatic small PDA: observation
- Hemodynamically significant PDA (hsPDA) — see criteria above
- Duct-dependent CHD (cyanotic / left obstructive) — KEEP open with PGE1 — см. neo-pge1 (отдельный calc)

TREATMENT OPTIONS — choose based on contraindications:

OPTION 1: IBUPROFEN (preferred — Mitra JAMA 2018)
- Standard: 10/5/5 мг/кг q24h × 3 дня
- High-dose Hirt 2008 (< 27 нед): 20/10/10 мг/кг
- Closure rate ~ 70 %
- Better GI/renal safety vs indomethacin
- См. neo-ibuprofen-pda-dose calc

OPTION 2: INDOMETHACIN (если ибупрофен недоступен)
- Standard: 0.2 мг/кг IV × 1 → 0.1 мг/кг q12h × 2 (если < 48 ч)
- IVH prophylaxis у ELBW: 0.1 мг/кг q24h × 3 (TIPP Schmidt 2001)
- Closure rate ~ 70 %
- Higher mesenteric/renal vasoconstriction → больше NEC, oliguria

OPTION 3: PARACETAMOL (Allegaert 2014, 3-я линия)
- 15 мг/кг q6h × 3-7 дней (PO/IV)
- Closure rate ~ 60 % (Cochrane 2019)
- Better safety profile vs NSAIDs
- Showings: NSAID contraindications (renal failure, thrombocytopenia, NEC, GI bleed)

OPTION 4: CONSERVATIVE (BeNeDuctus NEJM 2022)
- Asymptomatic / non-significant PDA у GA > 30 нед
- Most spontaneously close к 12 нед PMA
- Pharm closure не улучшает long-term outcomes (TIPP 2001 + BeNeDuctus 2022)

OPTION 5: SURGICAL LIGATION
- Refractory hsPDA после 2 courses pharm therapy
- Symptomatic при contraindications к pharm
- Risk: recurrent laryngeal nerve injury, chylothorax, post-ligation cardiac syndrome

CONTRAINDICATIONS к NSAID closure:
- Active hemorrhage / тромбоцитопения < 50 × 10⁹/л
- NEC active / suspected
- Renal failure (Cr > 1.5 мг/дл, диурез < 1 мл/кг/ч × 8 ч)
- Active sepsis
- Right-to-left shunt (duct-dependent CHD)
- Coagulopathy

MONITORING:
- Echo через 24-48 ч после course (PDA assessment)
- Cr / urea / диурез q24h
- CBC (тромбоцитопения)
- Гликемия

AFTER CLOSURE:
- Confirm absence ductal flow (echo)
- Wean ventilator support
- Resume normal feeding
references: Mitra S et al. JAMA 2018;319:1221 — comparative meta-analysis
Ohlsson A et al. Cochrane Ibuprofen for PDA 2020
Hundscheid T et al. NEJM 2022;387:683 (BeNeDuctus)
Schmidt B et al. TIPP trial NEJM 2001;344:1966
Allegaert K et al. Pediatrics 2014;134:e253 (paracetamol)
КР МЗ РФ "Открытый артериальный проток у н/р" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DIAGNOSIS (NIH consensus 2018):
Severity assessment at 36 wk PMA — см. neo-bpd-nih calc:
- No BPD: room air
- Mild: ≥ 28 days O₂ requirement, off O₂ at 36 wk PMA
- Moderate: < 30 % FiO₂ at 36 wk PMA
- Severe: ≥ 30 % FiO₂ или PPV/CPAP at 36 wk PMA

EVALUATION:
- Echo: pulmonary HTN screen (TR jet velocity, RV pressure, septal flattening)
- Chest X-ray: cystic-emphysematous changes, areas of consolidation
- Blood gas: chronic respiratory acidosis (compensated)
- Growth chart: feeding adequacy assessment

PROPHYLAXIS / EARLY MANAGEMENT:
- Antenatal corticosteroids (betamethasone 12 мг IM × 2)
- Surfactant ASAP (LISA preferred у ≥ 26 нед на CPAP)
- Caffeine 20 мг/кг loading + 5-10 мг/кг q24h (CAP trial — Schmidt 2007 NEJM)
- Permissive hypercapnia (PaCO₂ 45-55, pH ≥ 7.25)
- Avoid hyperoxia (target SpO₂ 90-95 %)
- Volume restriction (if signs of fluid overload)

ESTABLISHED BPD:

1. RESPIRATORY:
- Wean to lowest effective FiO₂
- Гомеопатический подход: SpO₂ target 90-95 % (NeOProM 2018)
- Bronchodilator (albuterol) ad-hoc для wheezing
- Nebulized budesonide 200-500 мкг q12h (controversial — Bassler NEUROSIS 2015 mortality concern)

2. SYSTEMIC STEROIDS (если ventilator-dependent ≥ 14 дней):
- Dexamethasone DART regimen low-dose late (Doyle 2006):
  · Day 1-3: 0.075 мг/кг q12h
  · Day 4-6: 0.05 мг/кг q12h
  · Day 7-9: 0.025 мг/кг q12h
  · Day 10: 0.01 мг/кг q12h
  · Cumulative 0.89 мг/кг
- ⚠️ AVOID extreme preterm < 28 нед в первые 7 d (Yeh 1998 NEJM 338:101 — cerebral palsy concerns)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8h × 5 d — alternative (less concerning vs dexamethasone)

3. DIURETICS:
- Furosemide 1-4 мг/кг q12-24h (acute) или PO chronic
- + Spironolactone 1-3 мг/кг q24h (potassium-sparing)
- + KCl supplementation 1-3 мэкв/кг/сут
- Cochrane 2017: short-term improvement только

4. NUTRITION:
- Caloric goals 130-150 ккал/кг/сут (BPD ↑ metabolic demand)
- Protein 4.0-4.5 г/кг/сут до 1000 г
- Fortified breastmilk или specialized preterm formula
- Vit A 5000 ед/кг IM 3×/нед × 4 нед (Tyson 1999 NEJM — ↓ BPD)

5. MONITORING:
- Echo: pulmonary HTN screen q3 мес если established BPD
- Sildenafil 0.5-3 мг/кг q6-8h если PHTN confirmed
- Eye exams (ROP risk)
- Hearing screen (Aminoglycoside ototoxicity)
- Renal U/S (nephrocalcinosis у chronic furosemide)

DISCHARGE:
- Home O₂ if persistent O₂ requirement
- Pulmonologist follow-up
- RSV palivizumab (15 мг/кг IM monthly) — eligible per AAP COFN 2014/2023
- Influenza vaccine (annual ≥ 6 мес)
- Avoid second-hand smoke, daycare exposure
references: Jobe AH, Bancalari E. NIH BPD consensus 2001 + Higgins 2018
Schmidt B et al. CAP trial NEJM 2007;357:1893
Doyle LW DART trial Pediatrics 2006;117:75
Yeh TF et al. NEJM 1998;338:101
Tyson JE et al. NEJM 1999;340:1962 (vit A)
Cochrane Diuretics for BPD 2017
AAP CFN — BPD management
КР МЗ РФ "БЛД" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DIAGNOSIS — см. neo-pphn-screen calc:
- Differential cyanosis (pre-ductal SpO₂ > post-ductal by > 5-10 %)
- Hypoxemia disproportionate к lung disease
- Echo: TR jet > 2.5 м/с, RV pressure ≥ 2/3 systemic, R→L shunting через PDA/PFO
- Hyperoxia test: PaO₂ < 100 мм рт ст на 100 % O₂ × 10 мин

STEPWISE TREATMENT:

STEP 1: OPTIMIZE VENTILATION
- Adequate PEEP 5-8 cmH₂O
- MAP optimization
- Avoid extremes: target PaCO₂ 40-50, pH 7.30-7.40
- Surfactant если RDS / MAS
- HFOV consider если conventional не optimal

STEP 2: CORRECT UNDERLYING
- Acidosis: NaHCO₃ только если pH < 7.20 + adequate ventilation
- Hypocalcemia: Ca gluconate 1-2 мл/кг 10 % IV slow
- Hypoglycemia: D10W 2 мл/кг bolus + GIR 6-8 мг/кг/мин
- Sepsis: empiric abx (см. sepsis algorithm)
- Polycythemia (Hct > 65 %): partial exchange (см. neo-partial-exchange calc)

STEP 3: SEDATION + MUSCLE RELAXATION
- Morphine 10-30 мкг/кг/ч infusion
- Fentanyl 1-3 мкг/кг/ч (alternative)
- Vecuronium 0.1 мг/кг q1-4h prn (если sympathetic surge severe)

STEP 4: iNO (см. neo-ino-dose)
- Initial 20 ppm × 30-60 мин trial
- Response: PaO₂ ↑ ≥ 20 мм рт ст или OI ↓ ≥ 15 % за 30 мин
- If response: continue, taper к 5-10 ppm
- Wean q4-12h до 1 ppm; off attempt при FiO₂ < 50 %
- Methemoglobinemia monitoring q12-24h

STEP 5: ADDITIONAL VASODILATORS (если iNO inadequate)
- Sildenafil PO 0.5-3 мг/кг q6-8h (PDE5 inhibitor — см. neo-sildenafil)
- Sildenafil IV LOAD-SUSTAIN: 0.4 мг/кг loading × 3 ч + 1.6 мг/кг/сут
- Used для iNO weaning support (sustains effect)

STEP 6: INODILATORS (если RV dysfunction)
- Milrinone 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин (PDE3 inhibitor — см. neo-milrinone)
- Synergy с iNO (Khanna CHEST 2017)
- ↑ Contractility + ↓ SVR/PVR одновременно

STEP 7: VASOPRESSORS (если systemic hypotension)
- Dopamine 5-15 мкг/кг/мин first-line
- Norepinephrine 0.05-1 мкг/кг/мин (warm shock)
- Vasopressin 0.0001-0.001 ед/кг/мин (refractory, catecholamine-resistant)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8h (relative adrenal insufficiency)

STEP 8: ECMO
- ELSO 2017 criteria: OI ≥ 40 sustained × 4 ч
- Or A-aDO₂ ≥ 600 мм рт ст × 8-12 ч у term/late preterm
- Connect ECMO center early (preparation may take hours)

ALTERNATIVE / ADJUNCT:
- MgSO₄ 200 мг/кг IV bolus + 100-150 мг/кг/ч (last-line, rare у н/р)
- Bosentan PO 1-2 мг/кг q12h (chronic PHTN, off-label у н/р)
- ECMO bridge to recovery

PROGNOSIS:
- Mortality severe PPHN: 10-30 %
- Survivors с BPD/CLD common
- Long-term pulmonary HTN rare если acute resolves

AAP COFN — pediatric pulmonary hypertension
NINOS trial Pediatrics 1997
Khanna A et al. CHEST 2017 (milrinone meta-analysis)
Baquero H et al. Pediatrics 2006 (sildenafil)
Konduri GG et al. — PPHN management guidelines
ELSO ECMO Guidelines
КР МЗ РФ "Персистирующая лёгочная гипертензия н/р" (2024)

guidelines.content:
ASSESSMENT — см. neo-finnegan calc (Modified Finnegan / mFNAS):
- 22 признака × 0-5 баллов, max 47
- Оценка q3-4h после кормления первые 96-120 ч жизни
- Bands: ≤ 7 поддерживающие меры; 8-11 наблюдение + adjunct; ≥ 12 фармакотерапия

PHARMACOTHERAPY TRIGGERS (AAP 2012):
- 3 последовательных оценок mFNAS ≥ 8
- ИЛИ 2 последовательных оценок ≥ 12

FIRST-LINE (опиоид-преобладающий withdrawal):

MORPHINE PO (см. neo-morphine-dose):
- Initial: 0.04-0.08 мг/кг q3-4h PO
- Titration: ↑ 10-20 % q24h до mFNAS < 8 stable × 24 ч
- Maximum: 0.16 мг/кг q3h (resistant)
- Tapering: ↓ 10 % q24h после 48 ч stable
- Прекращение: при дозе < 0.024 мг/кг q3h
- Continued mFNAS до 24-48 ч после стопа

SECOND-LINE / ADJUNCT (autonomic symptoms dominant):

CLONIDINE PO (см. neo-clonidine):
- 1 мкг/кг q3-4h PO (max 5 мкг/кг q3h)
- Combine с morphine для autonomic effects
- Particularly useful в polysubstance withdrawal
- Agthe Pediatrics 2009: ↓ hospitalization length 27 %
- Tapering: ↓ 10-20 % q24h после morphine wean

PHENOBARBITAL PO (см. neo-phenobarbital):
- 5 мг/кг q12h PO (polysubstance / non-opioid component)
- Loading 15-20 мг/кг IV/PO once если severe
- Less commonly used vs clonidine

ALTERNATIVE: ESC (Eat-Sleep-Console) NEJM 2023
- Function-based assessment (eat, sleep, console)
- Снижает medication use + LOS vs Finnegan-driven
- Family-centered approach

NON-PHARMACOLOGICAL MEASURES (всем):
- Кенгуру (skin-to-skin) с матерью (если consenting + safe)
- Грудное вскармливание (если mother NOT actively using)
- Тихая dark environment
- Swaddling (пеленание)
- Frequent small feedings
- Sucking (pacifier)

FAMILY/MATERNAL CARE:
- Maternal medication-assisted treatment (MAT) — methadone or buprenorphine
- НЕ stop maternal opioids cold-turkey
- Social work evaluation
- Discharge planning
- Outpatient follow-up arranged

MATERNAL OPIOIDS — ONSET OF NAS:
- Heroin / short-acting opioids: 24-72 ч
- Methadone: 72-96 ч (peak)
- Buprenorphine: до 14 дней
- SSRI / benzo: variable, often delayed

DURATION OF HOSPITALIZATION:
- Average 5-30 days depending on severity
- Mother + infant joint hospitalization preferred
- ESC may shorten LOS by 30-50 %

NALOXONE — CONTRAINDICATED:
- ⚠️ NEVER use naloxone у opioid-dependent newborns (precipitates withdrawal seizures)
- Differs from acute opioid overdose management

LONG-TERM:
- Behavioral / cognitive concerns
- Early intervention services
- Family-centered support
references: Hudak ML, Tan RC. AAP NAS Pediatrics 2012;129:e540
Agthe AG et al. Pediatrics 2009;123:e849
ESC trial NEJM 2023 — function-based assessment
Finnegan LP. Addict Dis 1975;2:141
MDCalc Modified Finnegan
КР МЗ РФ "Неонатальный абстинентный синдром" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DEFINITIONS:
- Apnea: pause in breathing > 20 seconds, ИЛИ shorter если associated with bradycardia (< 80 уд/мин), cyanosis, или desaturation (SpO₂ < 80 %)
- Periodic breathing: 3+ pauses ≥ 3 sec separated by < 20 sec of regular breathing — normal у preterm

TYPES:
- Central apnea (40 %): no respiratory effort, no airflow
- Obstructive apnea (10 %): respiratory effort but no airflow (airway obstruction)
- Mixed apnea (50 %): central + obstructive components

RISK FACTORS:
- Prematurity (peak 28-34 нед PMA)
- Sepsis
- Hypoxia
- Anemia (Hb < 8 г/дл)
- Hypoglycemia
- Electrolyte abnormalities (hypoCa, hypoNa)
- Maternal medications (opioids, magnesium)
- Seizures (subtle)
- GERD
- Neurologic injury (IVH, HIE)

WORKUP:
- CBC, electrolytes (Na, K, Ca, Mg, glucose)
- Blood gas (acidosis может ↑ apnea)
- Sepsis workup если new onset (CBC + diff, CRP, blood culture, LP по показаниям)
- Echo (PDA, PHTN)
- Head US (IVH)
- EEG если seizure suspected
- Polysomnography (rarely needed у н/р)

TREATMENT — STEP 1: STIMULATION
- Tactile stimulation (rubbing back, foot)
- Position: prone or lateral (NOT supine для apnea)
- Suctioning if airway obstruction

STEP 2: METHYLXANTHINES (см. neo-caffeine-dose)
- CAFFEINE CITRATE preferred:
  · Loading: 20 мг/кг IV/PO
  · Maintenance: 5-10 мг/кг q24h IV/PO
  · Therapeutic: 5-25 мкг/мл; toxicity > 40 мкг/мл
- Theophylline alternative (less preferred — narrower therapeutic window, more side effects)

STEP 3: RESPIRATORY SUPPORT
- Nasal CPAP 5-7 cmH₂O — first-line for moderate-severe AOP
- HFNC (high-flow nasal cannula) — alternative
- BiPAP — refractory cases
- Mechanical ventilation — severe / persistent / multi-system

STEP 4: ADJUNCTS
- Doxapram 0.5-1.5 мг/кг/ч IV — refractory AOP (rare у newborn, limited evidence)
- Transfusion если Hb < 8 г/дл (controversial)
- Treat sepsis empirically
- Anti-reflux measures если GERD suspected

MONITORING:
- Continuous cardiopulmonary monitor in NICU
- SpO₂ continuous
- Apnea events log: count, duration, severity
- Daily review for trend

CAFFEINE — CAP TRIAL (Schmidt 2007 NEJM 357:1893):
- 2006 ELBW newborns randomized
- ↓ BPD (RR 0.63)
- ↓ PDA closure rate
- ↓ Severe ROP
- ↓ Cerebral palsy / cognitive delay 18-21 мес
- 5-year follow-up: improved neurodevelopment

DISCONTINUATION:
- After PMA 33-36 нед
- AND ≥ 5-7 days apnea-free WITHOUT caffeine
- Tapering NOT needed (long t½ 60-100 ч у preterm)
- Some centers continue if persistent events at expected age

DISCHARGE:
- Apnea-free ≥ 5-7 days
- Off methylxanthines
- Mature respiratory pattern
- Home apnea monitor — controversial (NOT routinely recommended)
references: Schmidt B et al. CAP trial NEJM 2007;357:1893
Schmidt B et al. CAP follow-up NEJM 2012;366:1893
AAP CFN — Apnea of prematurity (Eichenwald EC 2018)
Cochrane Caffeine for AOP 2010
КР МЗ РФ "Апноэ недоношенных" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DEFINITION:
Hb < 8.5 г/дл (term) или < 9-10 г/дл (preterm) — physiologic nadir к 8-12 нед age у term, к 4-6 нед у preterm.

PATHOPHYSIOLOGY:
- ↓ Erythropoietin response
- Shortened RBC lifespan (60-90 d у preterm vs 120 d у term)
- Iatrogenic blood loss (lab draws ~ 1 мл/кг/нед)
- Hemodilution due to rapid growth

ASSESSMENT:
- Hb / Hct trend
- Reticulocyte count (low у true AOP)
- Iron studies: ferritin, transferrin saturation
- Vit B12, folate (rarely deficient у н/р)
- Bilirubin (rule out hemolysis)
- Coombs test if hemolysis suspected
- Symptoms: tachycardia, tachypnea, poor feeding, lethargy, growth failure

CLASSIFICATION BY SEVERITY:
- Mild: asymptomatic, Hb > 7-8 г/дл — observation + iron
- Moderate: symptomatic Hb 7-9 г/дл — Epo + iron
- Severe: Hb < 7 г/дл с symptoms — transfusion

TREATMENT OPTIONS:

OPTION 1: SUPPORTIVE
- Iron supplementation 2-6 мг/кг/сут elemental PO (см. neo-iron-dose):
  · Preterm 2-4 мг/кг/сут с 2-4 нед age
  · AOP + Epo: 6 мг/кг/сут OBLIGATORY
- Folic acid 50 мкг/кг/сут
- Vit E 25 ед/сут
- Adequate nutrition (protein 4 г/кг/сут VLBW)
- Minimize blood draws (microsampling)

OPTION 2: ERYTHROPOIETIN — см. neo-erythropoietin-dose
- rhEpo 250-500 ед/кг 3×/нед SC (preterm AOP)
- ИЛИ Darbepoetin alfa 10 мкг/кг 1×/нед SC (alternative)
- ⚠️ Iron OBLIGATORY 4-6 мг/кг/сут — без iron Epo не работает
- Cochrane 2014: ↓ transfusion need 12 %; no functional benefit
- Длительность: до PMA 32-34 нед или discharge

OPTION 3: PACKED RBC TRANSFUSION
- Threshold (severe AOP):
  · Symptomatic + Hb < 7 г/дл
  · Asymptomatic + Hb < 6 г/дл
  · Mechanical ventilation + Hb < 10 г/дл
  · Cardiac disease + Hb < 12 г/дл
- Volume: 10-15 мл/кг over 3-4 ч (slow infusion)
- Aim Hct rise ~ 5 % per 10 мл/кг
- Irradiated, leukocyte-depleted, CMV-safe для preterm
- Restrictive vs liberal: ETTNO + PINT trials — liberal не improves outcomes

PREVENTION (KEY):
- Delayed cord clamping ≥ 60 sec at birth
- Umbilical cord milking (UCM) — alternative if DCC not feasible
- Microsampling lab draws (point-of-care testing)
- Group orders to minimize draws
- Conservative transfusion threshold

MONITORING ON Epo:
- CBC weekly
- Reticulocyte count baseline + 2 нед
- Iron studies (ferritin) q4 нед
- Effect: Hb ↑ 4-6 нед, reticulocytes ↑ 1-2 нед

PENUT TRIAL (Juul 2020 NEJM 382:233):
- 941 extremely preterm
- Epo 1000 ед/кг IV q48h × 6 doses for neuroprotection
- ↓ Transfusions (modest)
- NO neurodev benefit
- → Не routine для preterm neuroprotection

OLD ROP CONCERNS DISPROVED:
- Cochrane 2014 + PENUT 2020: Epo НЕ повышает severe ROP risk
references: Aher SM et al. Cochrane Erythropoietin для AOP 2014
Juul SE et al. PENUT trial NEJM 2020;382:233
ETTNO trial JAMA Pediatr 2020
PINT trial Whyte R Pediatrics 2009
AAP COFN 2010 Iron requirements
ESPGHAN 2014 Iron supplementation в preterm
КР МЗ РФ "Анемия новорождённого" (2024)

guidelines.content:
DEFINITIONS (PES 2015 — Thornton):

TERM (asymptomatic):
- First 4 ч: < 1.8 ммоль/л (< 35 мг/дл) operational threshold
- 4-24 ч: < 2.0 ммоль/л (< 40 мг/дл)
- > 24 ч: < 2.6 ммоль/л (< 47 мг/дл)
- > 48 ч (target): ≥ 4.0 ммоль/л (≥ 70 мг/дл)

PRETERM / SYMPTOMATIC: < 2.6 ммоль/л — лечить ВСЕГДА

SEVERE: < 1.4 ммоль/л (< 25 мг/дл) — emergency

AT-RISK NEWBORNS (screen):
- LGA (> 90-й перцентиль)
- SGA (< 10-й перцентиль)
- IDM (infant of diabetic mother)
- Preterm < 37 нед
- Sepsis
- Hypothermia
- Asphyxia
- Polycythemia (Hct > 65 %)

SCREENING SCHEDULE:
- 30 мин после рождения (пуповинный или heel-prick)
- Повтор q30-60 мин × first 4 ч
- Затем q3-4h до stable × 24 ч
- POC glucose acceptable; lab confirmation если < 1.4 ммоль/л

TREATMENT — см. neo-glucose-bolus-dose calc:

STEP 1: ENTERAL FEEDING (asymptomatic, mild)
- Breast milk или formula 5-10 мл/кг within 30 мин
- Re-check glucose 30 мин после feed
- Если improvement → continue regular feeding q2-3h

STEP 2: IV BOLUS (symptomatic ИЛИ severe ИЛИ failure feeding)
- 2 мл/кг D10W IV slow push 1-2 мин (= 200 мг/кг = 0.2 г/кг)
- Severe (< 1.4 ммоль/л + symptomatic): 5 мл/кг D10W IV
- Re-check glucose 30 мин после bolus

STEP 3: CONTINUOUS GIR (см. neo-gir calc)
- Start 6-8 мг/кг/мин (≈ 80-110 мл/кг/сут D10W)
- Titrate: ↑ 2 мг/кг/мин q15-30 мин если persistent
- Max peripheral GIR: D12.5W (limited concentration)
- Beyond: central доступ + D15-20W

STEP 4: REFRACTORY HYPOGLYCEMIA (GIR ≥ 12-15 мг/кг/мин persistent)
- Workup CHI: insulin/glucose ratio > 0.3 при гипогликемии
- β-OH butyrate inappropriately низкий (< 1 ммоль/л)
- Free fatty acids inappropriately низкие
- Glucagon, cortisol, GH, lactate, ammonia
- Genetic testing: KCNJ11, ABCC8 (KATP), GLUD1, GCK, HADH

STEP 5: CHI EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT
- Glucagon 0.1-0.3 мг/кг IM/IV (см. neo-glucagon)
- Continuous infusion 0.005-0.02 мг/кг/ч (bridge to diazoxide)
- Diazoxide 5-15 мг/кг/сут PO q8h (см. neo-diazoxide) + chlorothiazide 7-10 мг/кг q12h
- Octreotide 5-25 мкг/кг/сут SC (если KATP-resistant)
- Hydrocortisone 1-2 мг/кг q8h (adrenal insuff trial)

STEP 6: SURGICAL
- 18F-DOPA PET — focal vs diffuse CHI distinction
- Focal CHI: partial pancreatectomy (curative)
- Diffuse CHI: chronic medical management

MONITORING:
- Glucose q15-30 мин после bolus initially
- Gradually space к q1h, q4h когда stable
- Goal: glucose 4-8 ммоль/л (70-150 мг/дл)

AVOID:
- D50W (50 % glucose) — высокая osmolality, ↑ риск IVH у preterm
- Rapid bolus > 5 мл/кг — rebound hyperglycemia, hyponatremia
- Sudden cessation continuous infusion — может precipitate severe rebound hypoglycemia

CAUSES SUSTAINED HYPOGLYCEMIA:
- Hyperinsulinism (CHI, IDM, BWS)
- Counter-regulatory hormone deficiency (cortisol, GH)
- Glycogen storage disease
- Fatty acid oxidation defects (MCAD)
- Disorders gluconeogenesis (FBPase, G6Pase)
- Galactosemia
